messages:
emma_cs: Quick preflight - QuasarLabs renewal is slated for Tue Apr 12. They asked to sign early. Current commit $180k/yr, 12mo. Procurement insists on a PO; Sales is pushing for an early-renew discount. Need legal, finance, and enablement checks before sending DocuSign. Who can pick this up?

raj_sales: I can run the discount convo. They've asked for 10% if we can fast-track signature. I already shared SOW v3 with Marta. Approver is the CFO + procurement ops.

marta_legal: On it. I saw SOW v3 — they removed our data-residency clause which we should re-add. If Sales wants a 10% concession we'll need to lock SLA language and a pricing guardrail. I'll draft a redline, ETA EOD.

oliver_fin: Finance notes: vendor code missing and we prefer Net30. If they send a PO that's ideal; if it's CC, we'll need cardholder info. Also confirm whether this counts toward Dedicated capacity uplift for billing.

liam_enablement: Enablement can prep a 30/60/90 onboarding checklist and a short feedback survey to capture why they renewed early. Can we also get a short list of key contacts + technical owners to invite to the session?

maya_soleng: From SE: account health is OK but they had token spikes on inference pipelines last month. Recommend advising them on quantization and prefix/KV caching before handoff. I'll add performance notes to the playbook.

emma_cs: Action items: @marta_legal do the redline; @oliver_fin confirm vendor code/payment path; @raj_sales confirm discount approval; @liam_enablement prep enablement checklist and survey. Also need final signer list for DocuSign (CFO + procurement).

marta_legal: Uploaded initial redline to internal drive: https://gdrive.company/repl/quasar_sow_redline — making small edits. If Sales confirms a discount, add clause: `pricing guardrail — no further concessions without CFO email`.

raj_sales: Quick update from CFO: they can accept 8% not 10%. Can we accommodate 8% and keep SLA language? @marta_legal?

marta_legal: 8% is acceptable. I'll update SOW and preserve the SLA wording.

oliver_fin: Confirmed vendor code: VL-789. Net30. If they need monthly invoicing note that in invoice terms. PO preferred; we'll accept a PO tied to VL-789.

liam_enablement: Got it — I'll create the enablement playbook and add a 30/60/90 checklist plus a 3-question survey that includes "reason for early renewal." Tagging @maya_soleng for technical runbook items.

maya_soleng: Adding perf notes to the playbook. Suggest enabling prefix caching and a conservative batcher config to smooth spikes. Snippet for the runbook:

```
batcher.config.max_batch_time_ms = 15
cache.kv_prefix = true
```

emma_cs: Perfect. Who will send the final DocuSign once Marta updates the SOW and Finance confirms? @raj_sales or me?

raj_sales: I'll send DocuSign after Marta uploads the final SOW and Finance confirms the PO. ETA tomorrow morning.

emma_cs: :thumbsup: I'll log the renewal in Gainsight and flag as at-risk if signature is delayed >7 days.

oliver_fin: Note - if signature slips beyond the renewal window we may need to apply a billing hold clause. Keep me posted.

marta_legal: Redline finished: replaced 10% with 8%, re-added data-residency clause, and included the pricing guardrail. PTAL: https://gdrive.company/repl/quasar_sow_redline_v2

raj_sales: Sending DocuSign now -> https://docusign.company/abcdef (fields: CFO, procurement ops, vendor code VL-789). Adding @emma_cs as witness.

emma_cs: Received. I'll monitor and update this thread on signature status. Also requesting enablement to add question: 'What motivated the early renewal?' for our feedback loop.

liam_enablement: Will include: "What motivated the early renewal? (scale / cost / deadline / other)" in the survey. I'll prep the calendar invite template for the 60-min onboarding.

maya_soleng: Plan: 60-min tech onboarding 3 business days after signature. I'll prepare runbook + perf checklist.

emma_cs: Update: DocuSign completed at 5999991142. PO VL-789 received, invoice Net30. Enablement session scheduled Apr 12 10:00 PT. Closing loop; will follow up with feedback survey results after enablement. Thanks all.
